title.narrative: UNICEF’s technical assistance in Social and Behavior Change (SBC) strengthened systems and enhanced capacity of national and state governments to implement evidence-based WASH SBC strategies; nationwide campaigns mobilizing more than 300 million people, 50,500 community engagement initiatives for national flagship programmes  Swachh Bharat Mission (sanitation) and Jal Jeevan Mission (water). UNICEF developed the National WASH Communication Strategy for the Department of Drinking Water and Sanitation, Ministry of Jal Shakti, for converged and effective SBC planning and implementation of the next phases of SBM (3.0) and JJM (2.0) integrating critical aspects of community ownership, sustainability, and locally driven innovations.
